The '''Khai family''' were [[Human/Legends|Human]] members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], and descendants of the survivors of the crash-landing of ''[[Omen]]'' on the planet around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The wealthy family included at least three generations of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], including [[Thallis Khai]], his son, [[Gavar Khai]], and Gavar's daughter, [[Vestara Khai]]. However, Gavar's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Lahka Khai]], was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].

==History==
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Vestara Khai]]
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thallis Khai]] was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He, along with the rest of the Tribe, was descended from the survivors of the [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|crash]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]'' on the planet in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Omen" />

Thallis had at least one son, a [[Sith Saber]] named [[Gavar Khai]]. Gavar [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] woman, [[Lahka Khai]], with whom he had one daughter in [[27 ABY/Legends|27.5 ABY]]. Their daughter, [[Vestara Khai]], became the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]], after being the first being on Kesh to whom [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], spoke.<ref name="Omen" /> She went on to serve in the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]], and was the sole survivor of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] that was sent to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambush]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[43 ABY]].<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]], both Gavar and Vestara Khai took part in a tenuous alliance that the Tribe formed with the Skywalkers for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to defeat the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

The mission was unsuccessful, as Abeloth escaped. Vestara Khai continued to travel with the Skywalkers as they hunted Abeloth down, and her father eventually rose to a higher ranking in the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|armada]], commanding his own [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> Abeloth soon formed an alliance with Gavar and the Sith on Kesh, only to betray them and [[Destruction of Tahv|destroy]] their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Tahv]]. Lahka Khai was among the [[Death/Legends|casualties]], but Gavar had fallen under Abeloth's influence, and he joined [[Abeloth's fleet|her forces]]. Abeloth sent Gavar and several other Sith Sabers to ambush the Skywalkers, and they confronted the Jedi on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Vestara remained aligned with the Jedi for the [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|duel]], and she engaged her father in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. She ultimately defeated and killed him, resulting in her decision to become a Jedi and began a relation with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]].<ref name="Ascension" />
